place: Na Mueang, Laem Sor, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84140, Thailand
title: Beachside Eco Pool Villa Community with Wellness Clubhouse
blurb: A pre-launch community of 17 eco-conscious private pool villas on Laem Sor Beach, on Koh Samui’s quiet southern coast. Three- and four-bedroom homes of 317–423 m² with private pools, wrapped around a wellness clubhouse with an onsen, hot and cold plunge pools, a gym, sauna and rooftop restaurant. Off-plan, completing 2027 — from ฿18,000,000 leasehold or ฿20,000,000 freehold, on a milestone-linked payment plan.
detail:
A pre-launch development of just 17 private pool villas set on Laem Sor Beach, on the tranquil southern coast of Koh Samui. Designed around an eco-conscious, contemporary aesthetic — clean white forms, natural materials and generous glazing that opens each home to the light, the gardens and the sea.

Three villa types span three to four bedrooms. Type 1 offers three bedrooms plus a flexible mezzanine (configurable for up to five beds) across 380–423 m²; Types 2 and 3 are four-bedroom homes of 317–391 m². Every villa has a private pool, three or more parking spaces, and four to five bathrooms, on plots of roughly 284–354 m².

At the heart of the community is a wellness clubhouse: an onsen and hot-and-cold plunge pools, a fully equipped gym, sauna and steam rooms, a sunken lounge and a rooftop restaurant overlooking the coast. The setting is one of Samui’s most peaceful — a short drive from Lamai and the Kamalaya wellness sanctuary, with the island’s dining and amenities within easy reach.

OWNERSHIP
Homes are offered principally on a 30-year registered lease; freehold may be available to qualifying buyers, subject to eligibility and legal structuring.
There is no yearly lease fee — the price covers the land lease, the villa and its construction. A rent figure appears on the Land Office registration because the filing requires one, but nothing further is payable against it.
Thai law caps a registered lease at 30 years, so that is what goes on the title. A further term is registered as a new agreement at the time; the developer intends to renew. Land Office cost then is 1% registration plus 0.1% stamp duty on the recorded rent, plus legal fees.

PAYMENT SCHEDULE
Payments are released against verified construction milestones: as each stage completes the purchaser is notified, progress evidence can be provided, and the corresponding instalment falls due.
Reservation — ฿200,000, holding the villa for 30 days and credited to the purchase price (non-refundable)
Contract, within 30 days of reservation — 20% (inclusive of the reservation fee)
Piling complete — 10%
Foundation complete — 10%
Structure complete — 10%
Walls, doors, windows and tiling complete — 15%
Architectural finishes, M&E and sanitary systems complete — 15%
Furniture installation complete — 10%
Transfer and registration — 10%

The clubhouse and its facilities are owned and run by a dedicated operating company, which also handles guest check-in, concierge and hospitality services under a licensed hotel framework. Owners may opt into a rental management agreement, bringing their villa onto that same platform and service standard — or simply keep the house private.

Under active construction with completion targeted for 2027. Pre-launch pricing from ฿18,000,000 on the registered lease, or ฿20,000,000 freehold, with individual villa sizes, prices and availability confirmed on the current dated price and inventory sheet.
